claims.statement: If P and Q are probability laws on nonempty subsets of [n] invariant under all coordinate permutations, then D_2(P||Q)=D_2(Law_P(|S|)||Law_Q(|S|)). In particular this applies to a permutation-symmetric Boolean squared spectral law and its equal-marginal conditional-product I-projection.
claims.scope: Permutation-symmetric spectral sources; boundary cases by the usual support/limit convention.
claims.verification: Analytic KL chain-rule proof in REPORT.md Section 2; not independently reviewed.

claims.statement: For cardinality laws A,B on {0,...,n}, D_2(A||B)=sum_{k=0}^{n-1} A_{>=k} d_2(A_k/A_{>=k} || B_k/B_{>=k}). Thus on the orbit-symmetric class the entire K_occ is an exact sum of nested binary-event KL payments.
claims.scope: Finite cardinality laws with standard zero-mass conventions.
claims.verification: Analytic sequential-encoding/KL-chain-rule proof in REPORT.md Section 3; not independently reviewed.

claims.statement: If an actual Boolean spectral law assigns probability zero to event E, then K_occ>=-log_2(1-Q_r(E)); if its whole support lies in L, K_occ>=-log_2 Q_r(L). For odd permutation-symmetric Boolean functions this gives K_occ>=log_2(2c/[1-(1-2cr)^n]).
claims.scope: Exact support events under the influence-matched conditional-product law; odd symmetric corollary at uniform bias.
claims.verification: Binary data-processing proof in REPORT.md Section 4; not independently reviewed.

claims.statement: For the genuine Boolean sparse suspension F_m(y,x)=y(1-2 1_{x=0}), with p=2^{1-m}, the old-coordinate cardinality-event bank equals the full K_occ exactly. Hence it recovers Theta(m I) KL while the full unweighted signed-convolution L2 energy is only Theta(I). The single tail d_m=floor(m/2-sqrt(m ln m)) already gives a (1-o(1))m^2 p lower bound.
claims.scope: The exact sparse suspension family from the cited L2 obstruction; asymptotic m->infinity.
claims.verification: Analytic orbit-sufficiency plus Hoeffding/union-bound proof in REPORT.md Section 5; not independently reviewed.

preflight.note: The new event bank retains every cardinality scale and is not the refuted fixed/sub-half-depth labelled projection. Exact sufficiency is only claimed under full permutation symmetry, which recursive ternary majority lacks.
